summary: Iteration 2 focused on the two new features: (1) Estimate PDF download + email, and (2) Client Timeline detail page. Backend pytest suite expanded from 11 → 20 tests (all PASS): PDF returns valid application/pdf with %PDF signature + attachment disposition and requires auth; 404 for missing estimate; POST /api/estimates/{id}/send-email returns 400 (no client email), success (200 with email_id + sent_to) for delivered@resend.dev with Draft→Sent status transition, and 502 for undeliverable seed emails; GET /api/clients/{id}/detail returns client + filtered estimates (by client_id) + jobs/invoices (by client_name) + full summary object, plus 401/404 branches. Frontend Playwright verified: Clients page name & eye buttons navigate to /clients/:id; ClientDetail page renders header, 4 stat cards, and 3 sections + back-to-clients-btn works; Estimates rows expose pdf-estimate-{id} (Playwright download event fires with EST-2026-*.pdf filename) and email-estimate-{id} (fires backend call, Draft estimate transitions to Sent on success for delivered@resend.dev). No regressions on dashboard/nav.

minor.issue: Returns 502 for undeliverable client emails, but Cloudflare/ingress intercepts 5xx responses and replaces the friendly JSON body ('That client's email address looks undeliverable...') with a generic HTML 'origin web server returned an invalid or incomplete response' page. Frontend toast then surfaces that Cloudflare text instead of the intended friendly message. Recommendation: return 400 or 422 (4xx) with the same detail payload so the ingress does not rewrite the body.
Draft→Sent status transition happens even if the estimate was already Sent/Won/Lost (only skipped when currently Draft). Consider only auto-transitioning from Draft.
Jobs & invoices are matched by client_name (string) instead of client_id — renaming a client would orphan its jobs/invoices from the timeline. Consider persisting client_id on Job and Invoice.

integration_issues.issue: Toast shows raw Cloudflare error HTML text instead of the friendly backend detail message due to ingress rewriting the 502 body. See backend minor item — best fix is to return 4xx on the server so the JSON body passes through.

issues: Same low-contrast issue as iteration 1 — 'Estimates' heading text blends into dark teal marble background.
No visible issues — layout, stats, and sections render cleanly on white cards.

action_items: Change send-email undeliverable failure from HTTP 502 → 400/422 so ingress doesn't overwrite the JSON detail (real UX fix).
Consider client_id linkage for Jobs/Invoices instead of client_name (data-integrity improvement).

Optional: only transition Draft→Sent on the FIRST successful send (currently only skipped when not-Draft, so re-sending a Draft that already got status Sent from a prior send is fine — but if user manually set Follow-up, next send won't touch it, which is correct).
critical_code_review_comments: email_pdf.send_email raises HTTPException(502) on upstream 4xx/5xx — this is caught by ingress and stripped of body. Prefer 4xx for client-side email errors.
server.py still monolithic (760+ lines) — split by domain when time allows.
client_detail joins jobs/invoices by client_name rather than client_id — fragile to renames.
next_number still uses count_documents (race-condition prone) — same finding as iteration 1.
Estimates.js downloadPdf uses window.URL.createObjectURL/click pattern — works, but consider adding try/finally to always revokeObjectURL even on click errors.
